style:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one finished transparent character sprite for an original creature-collecting RPG set in mythological Greece.
Art direction: expressive hand-drawn 2D monster character design, clean dark colored outlines of medium weight, bold readable shapes, warm cel shading with at most three tones per material, small elegant painted highlights, appealing exaggerated anatomy and personality. A sophisticated storybook-adventure palette, lively saturated color, not a black silhouette and not pixel art. The animal and divine concept are fused into the creature's actual anatomy, not an ordinary animal wearing a costume. Original design with the memorable silhouette and simple visual logic of a creature-collecting game, no existing franchise character.
Composition: exactly ONE creature, full body visible including every extremity, centered square canvas, three-quarter view FACING LEFT (nose points to image left), roughly 80% of frame with clear empty margins, readable at 100 pixels. No platform, no ground, no cast shadow, no scenery, no labels, no text, no watermark, no frame. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with alpha; no checkerboard illustration, no colored backdrop. Keep translucent magic small and connected to the body.

beasts.name: Brontlet
beasts.concept: An eagle chick fused with a tiny thundercloud. Round fluffy cloud chest and thunderhead wing feathers, proud little hooked gold beak, slate-blue wing tips shaped into chunky zigzag lightning feathers, a bright butter-gold lightning crest growing from its forehead, oversized copper-gold talons. Stormy blue-grey and warm ivory body with gold accents. One brow cocked, puffing its chest as if it is the king of the mountain, despite tiny wings; one foot raised in a brave little strut. All wing feathers should read as part of the eagle, fluffy cloud volume only at chest and brows. Bright large amber eyes with readable pupils. Friendly, cocky, very huggable, not a baby chicken.
beasts.personality: Puffs up its cloud-ruff before every challenge. Its tiny thunderclaps are mostly bravado.
beasts.lore: Zeus's eagle and thunderbolt become a chick whose storm feathers are still growing.

beasts.name: Calfin
beasts.concept: A sturdy adorable baby bull fused with an ocean breaker. Rounded barrel body, deep turquoise upper body shading to seafoam mint on its belly, creamy foamy mane formed by curling sea crests. TWO horns sweep up into beautifully curled wave shapes, organically growing from the skull, ivory-to-turquoise with creamy foam edges. A broad rounded bovine muzzle, large kind dark teal eyes, little cloven hooves of wet dark sea stone, small fin-like ears and a tapering tail ending in a kelp-shaped fluke. Three subtle wave curls form natural markings on its flank. Cheerful and stubbornly affectionate; leaning forward with lowered head in a playful nudge, sturdy four-legged stance. Clearly a bull calf first, ocean wave second. No trident prop, no clothes.
beasts.personality: Greets friends with a wave of its horns and a nudge strong enough to topple a picnic.
beasts.lore: Poseidon's sea and bull imagery meet in a calf shaped by breaking surf.

beasts.name: Kilnclaw
beasts.concept: A squat friendly crab fused with a potter's kiln and bronze automaton. Its rounded terracotta carapace IS a tiny domed kiln, with three thick dark bronze structural bands, a little warm orange fire glowing inside an arched opening in the FRONT of the shell behind the face. Two mismatched bronze claws: one organically hammer/anvil-shaped huge squared working claw, the other a tiny dexterous rounded pincer. Four visible compact jointed walking legs, two large expressive amber eyes on stubby stalks, a soot-smudged brow. One tiny flame licks from the chimney-like shell crown, thick cheerful shape, no smoke cloud. Warm russet ceramic, oxidized teal seams, burnished bronze, ember orange. An earnest little craftsperson in a comically confident broad stance, raising its oversized claw as if proud of a job well done. Cute small juvenile, NOT an industrial robot and not a normal crab in armor.
beasts.personality: Fixes buckles while you sleep and waits proudly for someone to notice. Hums when its kiln is warm.
beasts.lore: An invented crab automaton inspired by Hephaestus's living craft and metalwork; the crab is not his historical sacred animal.

beasts.name: Glyphet
beasts.concept: A plump little owl fused with an illuminated scroll and Athena's bronze wisdom. Broad creamy facial disk flows into two curled parchment-like eyebrow feathers, one raised skeptically. Huge clever olive-gold eyes with dark pupils sit in naturally grown bronze-gold spectacle-shaped eye markings. Wing feathers overlap like folded ivory scroll pages with a few simple abstract teal geometric feather marks (NOT legible letters); chest feathers make a compact layered page-shaped ruff. A small olive-leaf feather crest, feet like tiny stylus nibs, warm olive-grey back with bronze accents and teal shadow. Looking left with head tilted inquisitively, one short wing resting against chin in a thoughtful pose. Owl anatomy remains clear, no held book, no clothes, no glasses accessory; conceptual features are feathers and natural markings.
beasts.personality: Tilts its head whenever you make a poor decision. Usually knows a better one.
beasts.lore: Athena's owl, olive, and wisdom become scroll-like feathers and watchful bronze eye markings.

beasts.name: Wickpup
beasts.concept: A gentle round black hound puppy fused with an underworld wayfinding lantern. A velvety charcoal and muted aubergine body with broad soft paws and oversized drooping pointed ears. The chest contains one warm pale-lilac lantern-like oval glow visible through three natural rib-like dark fur stripes, NOT a lantern necklace or worn object. Tail curls upward into one small cool lavender ghost-wisp flame. Two tiny ear-tip wisps echo the extra heads of Cerberus without making additional faces: exactly one head, two eyes. A tiny ivory lower fang peeks out of a hopeful smile; sleepy amber eyes, head tilted as if checking whether you are lost. Sitting protectively with one forepaw offered. Little bronze-gold pebble spots above the paws evoke funeral coins. Its spooky features feel reassuring, not scary, no fire-red or orange furnace palette, no spikes.
beasts.personality: Pretends it isn't sleepy. Its tail-light stays on until every companion has found the camp.
beasts.lore: A gentle echo of Cerberus, the hound guarding Hades's realm; its lantern is an original guiding-spirit motif.

beasts.name: Clashog
beasts.concept: A small stubborn boar piglet fused with a Greek hoplite shield and charging ram. Compact round stocky chest, enormous piggy blunt rust-red snout, tiny ivory upward tusks, thick short dark hooves. Its natural shoulder hide grows into two rounded bronze shield-like scutes with simple concentric rings, integrated into the body. A crimson mohawk of thick bristles arcs from brow to back like a Greek helmet crest; one bristle sticks up comically. Warm dusty-red fur, burnished bronze scutes, dark maroon shadows. Fur on forehead forms a bronze-toned helmet-like wedge naturally framing its narrowed determined eyes, no actual helmet or clothing. Leaning left into a spring-loaded charging stance, planting feet wider than necessary, trying very hard to look fearsome while clearly a plucky piglet. No spear, weapons props, human arms, or gore.
beasts.personality: Challenges boulders to staring contests. Leans against friends as fiercely as it charges foes.
beasts.lore: Ares's martial character inspires its shield-hide and crest. A boar-form Ares appears in one tradition about Adonis.

beasts.name: Dovelace
beasts.concept: An elegant but cheeky plump dove fused with a blooming rose and a love-knot ribbon. A creamy ivory bird body, dusty rose-pink wing feathers which fold in layered petal shapes, a warm blush rose rosette formed entirely from chest feathers. Tail feathers organically extend into TWO smooth ribbon-like streamers that loop into an open heart silhouette behind its body and end in real feather tips. Tiny coral beak, small rosy feet, bright dark plum eyes with mischievous confidence, a swept rose petal forelock. Half-spread one wing as if courteously inviting a shy companion to dance; head cocked toward image left. Beautiful flowing silhouette, petal wings still recognizably bird wings. No floating heart icon, no worn bow, no perfume bottle, no clothes; the heart is negative space in its tail, not a graphic symbol.
beasts.personality: Insists that everyone at camp make up before bedtime. Takes matchmaking far too seriously.
beasts.lore: Aphrodite's dove and rose imagery become petal wings and a tail that ties a living love-knot.

beasts.name: Solisk
beasts.concept: A cute slender golden serpent fused with a living sundial. Its lower body coils into one broad flat circular sun-dial disk, with twelve simple bronze scale wedges along the upper rim; raised neck rises from the center and curves toward image left like the sundial's gnomon. Small warm golden cobra-like cheek fins fan into seven short sun-ray points, forming a built-in radiant frill behind its single smiling snake face. Golden ochre upper scales, creamy sunlit belly, warm copper-red tail tip and scale-rim accents, clear bright amber eyes with dark pupils. The little tail curls playfully over the rim of its own coil. An eager basking prophet, proudly finding the warmest spot, slightly smug knowing smile. Reimagines the Python story through Apollo's Delphic and solar identity. Clearly snake anatomy, no limbs, no floating halo, no text, no numbers, no detached sun disk, no enormous magical aura.
beasts.personality: Always finds the warmest stone. Looks unbearably pleased when its little predictions come true.
beasts.lore: An original solar reinterpretation of the serpent at Delphi, joining the Python story to Apollo's light and prophecy.

beasts.name: Cresfawn
beasts.concept: A nimble young deer fused with a crescent moon and a living hunting bow. Slender soft fawn body with very large alert ears, moon-pale ivory belly, muted moss and warm tan upper coat, white star-like spots, tiny bronze cloven hooves. Two slender golden antlers gently sweep in crescents, and a fine visible silver silk-like natural strand connects the tips into a small bow silhouette above its forehead; do not put a separate bow on its body. Short feather-shaped tail resembling arrow fletching, subtly silver eyebrow markings. Shy yet mischievous large dark green eyes, looking back toward image left while poised on three hooves with one lifted, ready to dart away. Graceful slightly oversized fawn head, sweet mobile ears. Mythic anchor is Artemis's golden-antlered, bronze-hooved Ceryneian hind. No arrows held in mouth, no gear, no saddle.
beasts.personality: Plays hide-and-seek without announcing the game. Returns the moment a friend truly needs it.
beasts.lore: Artemis's Ceryneian hind lends its golden antlers and bronze hooves; the antlers grow into a moonlit bow.

beasts.name: Lyretto
beasts.concept: A surprisingly speedy little land tortoise fused with a lyre and Hermes's winged messenger. Its olive-teal domed shell forms the rounded soundbox of a lyre: two golden shell ridges grow upward into elegant curved lyre arms, a natural crossbar bridges them, and five fine pale strings run visibly across the domed shell. Two little ivory feather fans sprout at the rear edges of the shell like winged sandals translated to tortoise anatomy. Big determined eyebrows over mischievous amber eyes, small smiling beak, stout little limbs fully extended in a comic sprint toward image left. Dusty olive green body, bronze-gold shell edging, warm ivory shell belly, ochre strings. Instantly reads as tortoise + musical instrument + speedy messenger. No separate instrument carried, no clothes, no mail bag, no detached motion lines or background shadow.
beasts.personality: Steals the shortest route, then waits smugly at the crossroads. Its shell hums along with your lyre.
beasts.lore: Hermes made the first lyre from a tortoise shell; this courier grows its own strings and little messenger wings.

beasts.name: Sheafang
beasts.concept: A generous chestnut dormouse fused with a living granary: oat-cream cheek grain pouches, round leaf-lined ears, wheat forelock, tiny poppy tuft, short seedpod tail, and two grain-shaped incisors.
beasts.personality: Packs its cheeks for the whole camp, then shyly offers the biggest seed to whoever looks hungry.
beasts.lore: Demeter's wheat, barley, and poppies inspire this generous granary dormouse. Its leafy ears and grain pouches are an invented hybrid, not a historical sacred animal.
beasts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a completely reimagined Sheafang, the Harvest / Demeter starter beast for our Greek myth creature RPG. The two input images are STYLE references only: match their appealing full-color storybook illustration, soft cel shading, colored outlines, expressive eyes and polished hand-painted finish. Sheafang is now a tiny harvest DORMOUSE fused with a living grain pouch. A plump round warm chestnut-brown mouse body, enormous oat-cream cheeks naturally shaped like full seed pouches, warm cream belly, huge bright chestnut eyes, tiny pink nose, two small cream grain-shaped incisors visible in its hopeful smile. Big ROUND ears with folded green leaf interiors, three ripe golden wheat ears growing as a little swept forelock, leafy collar fur, four small mouse paws. A SHORT plump seedpod-shaped tail with two little green leaves, visibly no long serpent tail. Sparse golden grain-shaped fur tufts along its back, one tiny red poppy petal tuft near an ear. Sitting slightly upright with its front paws tucked near its full cheeks, as if eager to share supper. Clearly mouse anatomy and a compact round silhouette, not a snake, cobra, reptile or big cat. Keep wheat, barley, leaves and poppy motifs integrated into its actual anatomy, not worn clothing or carried farming gear. One creature, full body, centered square canvas, three-quarter front view facing LEFT, clear margins, genuine transparent PNG cutout. No scenery, ground, shadow, text or border.
beasts.cutoutPrompt: Use case: background-extraction. Create a transparent-background PNG of this exact creature sprite. Remove the checkered background completely. Keep the existing composition, colors, pose and creature artwork unchanged. Isolate just the creature and its anatomical feathers, fur, horns, tail or flame. All empty spaces between limbs and feathers are also transparent. Crisp opaque creature, fully transparent surrounding pixels, no floor, glow or shadow. Output genuine RGBA transparency, not a picture of a transparency grid.

beasts.name: Revelcub
beasts.concept: A playful panther cub fused with a grapevine and a Greek comedy mask. Chunky lilac-plum panther cub with a deep wine-purple back and warm cream muzzle and belly, oversized soft paws, big round ears and an extravagantly curled leafy vine tail. Its rosette spots naturally resemble little clusters of three grape-shaped circles, sparse and simple. A few deep green ivy leaves grow as a tousled forehead tuft and cheek ruff; an asymmetrical cream facial marking evokes the smiling side of an ancient theater mask without covering its real face. Its single open grin and laughing emerald-green eyes communicate a mischievous little festival host. Crouched in a play bow toward image left, one paw inviting you to pounce, tail curling up high with one large ivy-leaf tip. No bottle, goblet, clothing, accessory mask, intoxication or separate grapes; motifs are anatomy and coat markings.
beasts.personality: Turns every rest stop into a festival. Steals one fig, then offers you half with a shameless grin.
beasts.lore: Dionysus's panther, ivy, grapes, and theater meet in a cub with vine-tendrils and comedy-mask markings.

A sophisticated storybook-adventure palette, lively saturated color, not a black silhouette and not pixel art. The animal and divine concept are fused into the creature's actual anatomy, not an ordinary animal wearing a costume. No platform, no ground, no cast shadow, no scenery, no labels, no text, no watermark, no frame. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with alpha; no checkerboard illustration, no colored backdrop. Keep translucent magic small and connected to the body.
